name: vCard QR Generator
summary: Build a contact vCard QR code — name, phone, email, org, address — download PNG or SVG.
description: Fill in contact fields to generate a vCard 3.0 payload and QR code. Download PNG or SVG for sharing. Everything runs locally; contact details are not uploaded.

faqs.question: Which vCard version is used?
faqs.answer: vCard 3.0 — widely supported by phone cameras and contact apps.

faqs.question: Is a last name required?
faqs.answer: No. Either first or last name (or both) is enough to build FN.

faqs.question: Are my details uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The vCard and QR are generated entirely in your browser.
